mechanism: Nalmefene is a mu-opioid antagonist that may precipitate acute withdrawal in opioid-dependent patients and potentially reduce therapeutic efficacy of opioids used for pain management; hydrocortisone may mask withdrawal symptoms or complicate clinical assessment.
action: Assess opioid dependency status before nalmefene initiation; monitor for withdrawal symptoms; consider timing of corticosteroid use relative to opioid antagonist therapy; avoid concurrent use if patient requires opioid analgesia.
